# Input b8-4: the B8.4 synthetic submissions (PROVISIONAL)

- **What:** the fictional submissions of B8.4 (`testdata/b8-4-synthetic-submissions/`, merged in #31, #189 and #190), the input of the B8.6 grading-draft item `gd-001`. The set has 33 submissions (B8.4 needs at least 30). Each is graded on the marking table of its B8.2 task.
- **Source:** written for this project by Student 3 (B8.4). Entirely fictional. This set does not copy any submission: it points at the B8.4 set, so the two cannot drift apart.
- **Expected output:** the mentor reference grades of B8.4 (`reference-grades/mentor-01/`, one file per submission): all 33 exist (#221), written by the student the guide chose to act as mentor (issue #186, B8.4 open item O3) and labelled "student acting as mentor". The author's own grades stay labelled as not reference grades. A second grader on at least 10 submissions is for Release 4 (design Q47). So `gd-001` is ready, PROVISIONAL, and not reviewed.
- **In this tree:** B8.4 is merged, so its manifest and the reference grades exist here and the tests that read them run.
- **Status:** PROVISIONAL.
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0 (decided by the guide, issue #186).
